name: Default
shortDescription: Stem separation studio that splits songs into vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano and other tracks with Demucs, with a mixer for practice, karaoke and export.

alerts.message: StemDeck has no authentication by design: anyone who can open the domain can import songs, change settings and delete the library. Keep the domain private or put access control in front of it.
HTTPS is required: requests from other devices over plain HTTP are refused with a 403, so the domain must be served over HTTPS.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
